caption: The drawing consists of four horizontal rectangular bands arranged in parallel, each containing a distinct decorative pattern. The top band features a repeating geometric and floral motif with green circular designs, pink round shapes, and triangular segments separated by light cream and dark blue sections, bordered by thin brown lines at each end. The second band has a pink background with repetitive green plant-like figures, each topped by a pink circular element, and a thin green line runs along the bottom edge, with the top outlined in blue. The third band contains a cream-colored background with a waved light blue upper edge and is decorated with alternating symmetrical green and pink curling patterns, pink round shapes, and a single blue bird in the center-left. The fourth and bottom band has a beige background with abstract shapes, including a repeating green element resembling a stylized plant pot or arch, spaced by pink circles, and with curled green flourishes at either end. All bands are outlined at the ends by short brown vertical lines.
title: Vigas
